Elena —

Thanks for the attachments and for signing. Quick answers inline:

- Remit string: we include the PO number followed by the invoice number separated by a pipe. Example: PO#98321 | INV-2027-0114. Finance prefers that exact format for auto-matching.
- Sample remittance: attached is a one-line example and the standard remittance CSV export from our payops portal. See PO-98321-Redwood-API-Integration.pdf for the invoice reference.
- Micro-deposits: we will kick a pair of micro-deposits to the account listed in your spreadsheet within 24 hours of this email; once you confirm amounts we flip the vendor to live and schedule the initial payment.

Attachments:
- PO-98321-Redwood-API-Integration.pdf (pdf)
- remittance_sample.csv (csv)

Marissa from Finance (cc) will validate the remit format and confirm the payout schedule. Karthik is on the thread if there are any PO mapping questions for the integration.

Next steps:
1) BridgeAxis confirms micro-deposit amounts to payops@redwoodinference.com.
2) Finance completes verification and enables live vendor status.
3) First payment scheduled for the next weekly batch (Thursdays).

Best,
David Kim

Hi Elena / BridgeAxis finance team,

Quick note from Redwood Finance — thanks for sending the W-9 and the bank spreadsheet. A few clarifications so we can move to live payments: 

1) Micro-deposit verification: we will send two small deposits under $1.00 in the next 24 hours. Please reply to this thread with the exact cents received (e.g., $0.12 and $0.37). Once we receive confirmation, we enable the account for ACH.

2) Remittance file — we can provide both formats: an automated CSV (attached) and a human-readable remittance email body. The CSV headers are: remit_id, po_number, invoice_number, invoice_date, amount, payment_date, payment_method. If you are pulling from a portal, we also expose a read-only SFTP endpoint (details provided after PO validation) or a webhooks feed.

3) PO tagging — to ensure accounting alignment, include PO#98321 in the invoice header and in the remittance string exactly as David outlined. Our reconciliation job matches PO# + invoice id.

Attachment: remittance_sample.csv (csv)

If you prefer a short call to walk the portal and sample file, I can do 20 minutes today between 11–2 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Finance — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
